questions.question_en: Which soil relationship correctly identifies Sheet erosion?
questions.question_te: Sheet erosionను సరిగ్గా వివరించే ఎంపిక ఏది?
options: Small runoff channels that may be removed by ordinary tillage
Removal of material from stream or river banks
Large persistent erosion channels beyond normal tillage removal
Relatively thin widespread removal of surface soil
option_explanations: This describes rill erosion: its small channels may be erased by normal tillage.
This describes bank erosion caused by removal of river- or stream-bank material.
This describes gully erosion: normal tillage cannot remove its large persistent channels.
This describes sheet erosion, a relatively thin and widespread loss of topsoil.

questions.question_en: Which soil relationship correctly identifies Contour cultivation?
questions.question_te: Contour cultivationను సరిగ్గా వివరించే ఎంపిక ఏది?
options: Surface residue or cover reducing exposure and moisture loss
Vegetation grown partly to protect soil between or alongside crops
Cultivation aligned across slope along similar elevations
Creation of stepped surfaces to manage slope and runoff
option_explanations: This describes mulching, where surface cover reduces exposure and evaporation.
This describes a cover crop: living vegetation is used partly to protect the soil.
This describes contour cultivation across the slope along lines of similar elevation.
This describes terracing, which divides a slope into stepped surfaces.
